Classes

AlwaysUpdate

Allows a Component to be updated even if Osmium is only initialized

Component

The backing class for all Components in Osmium. Inherit this to become one.

ComponentDocker

Base class for both Scenes and Components. Responsible for Managing hierarchy between Components and Scenes and managing children, has Extensive Component Manipulation Available. Also transfers Time and Carries most of the responsibilities akin to the Component. NOT FOR OUTSIDE INHERITANCE (this is very under the hood, and meant to be mostly hidden), please use docker by inheriting component.

Debug
DebugMessage
Delay

Represents a timed delay in a coroutine, which can be used with yield return.

EditorOnly

Shows that a piece of code is used only for the Editor, and it should be ignored in the compilation phase

MarkerAttributes

Provides many handy cosmetic attributes for methods to specify use cases or provide information.

MarkerAttributes.CalculatedProperty

Shows that the given object is calculated every time it is called! Good to know for performance heavy systems.

MarkerAttributes.Complexity

Just a way to write the time complexity of a calculated property or method.

MarkerAttributes.ComplexityON

Just a way to write the time complexity of a calculated property or method.

MarkerAttributes.Expense

Just a way to write how expensive a calculated property or method can be.

MarkerAttributes.MethodLambda

Shows that the given method does not actually belong to the object, but instead just calls a lambda to another method.

MarkerAttributes.UnsafeInternal

Shows that the given object is unsafe (ex. it doesn't check for null values and such, or it doesn't have guardrails based on cases). This is just for internal/private methods to remind myself how to call it :) The reasoning is case by case, but most of the time, it is because all the exposing public methods already check, and double checks would only slow me down

MarkerAttributes.UnsafePipeline

The given function is missing many guiderails, and it should be used carefully.

MarkerAttributes.VariableLambda

Shows that the given variable does not actually belong to the object, but instead just calls a lambda to another method.

OnEditorOpen

Used to mark any method you would like to call once Osmium opens a project. Only static, parameterless, methods may be called. Your code will compile regardless, but your event will be ignored at runtime.

OnInitialize

Used to mark any method you would like to call once Osmium initializes. Only static, parameterless, methods may be called. Your code will compile regardless, but your event will be ignored at runtime.

Osmium

Bottom class of Osmium. Carries events from MonoGame into Scenes, and provides OpenTK context.

Scene

One of the main Osmium entities. Acts like a master folder for components to be stored in. Feel free to inherit this and make a custom scene!
